root.text:
[Unit]
Description=Restore the enrolled USB root through its stable device-mapper path
DefaultDependencies=no
ConditionKernelCommandLine=ram_rescue_guard=1
After=systemd-udevd.service systemd-remount-fs.service
Before=local-fs-pre.target sysinit.target ram-rescue-prepare.service shutdown.target
Conflicts=shutdown.target
OnFailure=emergency.target

[Service]
Type=notify
NotifyAccess=main
RootDirectory=/run/ram-rescue-demo
WorkingDirectory=/
ExecStart=/opt/guard-runtime/guard-runtime run --config /run/ram-rescue-guard/config.json
ExecStopPost=/opt/guard-runtime/guard-runtime takeover --config /run/ram-rescue-guard/config.json
Restart=no
TimeoutStartSec=30
TimeoutStopSec=15
CPUAccounting=yes
CPUQuota=20%
CPUQuotaPeriodSec=20ms
MemoryAccounting=yes
MemoryMax=128M
MemorySwapMax=0
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal

manager.text:
[Unit]
Description=Maintain enrolled USB mapping %i
Requires=ram-rescue-manager.service
After=ram-rescue-manager.service
Before=shutdown.target
Conflicts=shutdown.target

[Service]
Type=notify
NotifyAccess=main
Slice=ramrescuedata.slice
RootDirectory=/run/ram-rescue-demo
WorkingDirectory=/
Environment=PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
ExecStart=/opt/manager/maintain --record /run/ram-rescue-manager/entries/%i.json
ExecStopPost=/opt/manager/maintain --record /run/ram-rescue-manager/entries/%i.json --takeover
Restart=no
TimeoutStartSec=30
TimeoutStopSec=15
MemoryAccounting=yes
MemoryMax=128M
MemorySwapMax=0
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal
